verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents all three modes the story names. Sub-agents are background runs that parallelize research and long tasks without blocking the main run. Swarm orchestrates many concurrent sub-agents from Code Mode scripts, with bounded fan-out, structured results and live progress. An A2A channel plugin implements the Linux Foundation Agent2Agent 1.0 protocol for external agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sub-agent or swarm fan-out actually splits and parallelizes real work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work

citations.quote: Parallelize research, long tasks, and slow tool work without blocking the main run.
Sub-agents are background agent runs spawned from an existing agent run.
Orchestrate concurrent sub-agents from Code Mode scripts with structured results, bounded fan-out, and live progress
Use normal JavaScript control flow such as `Promise.all`, `while`, and `if` to fan out work, collect results, and make decisions.
The A2A channel plugin connects OpenClaw to other agents through the Linux Foundation Agent2Agent protocol
External agents discover the gateway through a public Agent Card and submit authenticated text tasks using the A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding.
